reference_role: Validated full original2020 global equilibrium method result; no independent thermodynamic truth
tolerance_rationale: Three independent public-derived source starts converge max scaled parameter spread1.65e-7; energy/physical parameters must agree while full observations constrain prediction. Column-normalized Jacobian rank18, minimum singular value0.0396. No crop or selected curve.

baseline.method: Original whole2020 global LMfit1.0.1 method with native public API precision refinement, all95430points

metric_definitions.energy_max_abs: max absolute free-energy difference in kJ/mol over all15x3181 points
metric_definitions.thermodynamic_scaled_max_abs: max component |estimate-reference|/max(1,|reference|), all4 declared parameter units
metric_definitions.baseline_max_abs: max absolute difference across both channel7-vectors in respective declared coefficient units
metric_definitions.observation_relative_l2: L2 of full95430 normalized-intensity residuals divided by L2 of observed normalized intensities
metric_definitions.energy_internal_consistency: max absolute kJ/mol difference of submitted energy and independent thermodynamic model of submitted4parameters
